big: The market is down 13%. A client asks, 'Should I put in my ₹10 lakh now?' Nobody can reliably call the bottom. It can fall further or recover, and both have happened many times.

lines: A lump sum gets money working sooner, and in rising markets tends to win. A SIP or STP spreads entry and reduces regret if markets fall more. An STP parks the money in a liquid or low-duration fund and moves fixed amounts to equity. The right choice depends on horizon, risk tolerance and how she would feel if markets fell another 10%.
